versions.subject: rule: HTran / NATBypass usage
versions.detection:
selection_name:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\htran.exe'
        - '\lcx.exe'
selection_flags1:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '.exe -tran '
        - '.exe -slave '
condition: 1 of selection*
